answer: The strongest single control I know for this is scoped API token with per-epoch rate envelope, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 654 aliases need 654 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. The pulse sits in the mechanism itself, the reef sits in the price of faking it, and the relic sits in the record no template can forge. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
